question: Does requiring pre-existing native chemical BONDS to conduct energy produce useful feedback relative to energy transfer across all adjacent contacts? Distinguish energy flowing along naturally emerged networks from generic diffusion.

design.sources: dispersed 16 sites x 2 units/tick as M7.1, capacity12, 19200 generated/world
design.source_config: identical to M7.2 dispersed_no_transfer and M7.1 driven_no_catalysis except new seeds

transport.stage: after original World.advance(1), no source/core changes
transport.common_rule: Snapshot particle energies. Unique undirected pairs sorted by persistent material IDs, gradient>=2 proposes single unit donor rich -> poor; donor budget limits acceptance. Simultaneous deltas, no RNG or energy created.
transport.all_contacts: M7.2 original diffuse_contact_energy unchanged, includes bonded and unbonded cardinal neighbors.
transport.bond_only: Exactly the currently existing original native chemical bond pairs, sorted by persistent material ID, irrespective of toroidal geometry. Bonds connect adjacent fixed members under M6. Only original chemical edges conduct; no transfer across nonbonded contacts. 1 unit per bond per step maximum.
transport.integrity: At every transfer pass assert exact particle energy conservation, unchanged RNG/draws, unchanged bonds/positions/species/particle IDs, no negative energy. At 6 checkpoints assert full accounting stored+dissipated+unabsorbed=initial+injected.

observations.per_world: Late accepted moves, new native bonds/breaks, bound/free particle energy sum and counts, free energy-qualified mobile monomers, zero-energy particles, particle energy Gini, total transfers broken down across existing chemical vs unbonded contacts, source overflow, native cyclic component count, stored energy.
observations.one_step_mechanistic_control: After a transfer from the same native state, no change in current bond-break probability (fixed 0.002 native and no source changes). Flow is NOT active repair.
observations.independent_units: 100 distinct numeric seeds, 3 matched regimes per seed; no per-tick pseudo-replication.
observations.sensitivity: Record whether bonded-only transfer occurs (at least one event), and how much of all-contact transport travels over real chemical bond edges.
observations.replay: For first numeric seed of each of 4 frozen shards repeat all 3 arms from scratch, require identical complete final material hash, RNG state and draw count, energy accounting, source overflow, transfers, chemical and movement counters.

gates.network_transport: At least 70/100 distinct seed worlds with >0 native bond-only energy transfers AND at least 60/100 with more new native bond formations in last 100 ticks than paired no_transfer. Both conditions mandatory.
gates.generic_contact_advantage: At least 75/100 seeds have more last-100 movements under all_contacts than bond_only AND at least 70/100 have fewer zero-energy particles at tick600 under all_contacts than bond_only. Both conditions mandatory.
gates.direct_bond_stabilization: No primary claim is permitted: base bond-break rate is fixed and independent of bonds/energy; source graphs are not matched after intervention. Report no direct mechanical bond-strength feedback.
